newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks higher, but off highs, in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks higher, but off highs, in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were slightly up, but off from early highs, in late Monday trade as buying turned cautious at around a 30-day-average resistance at 8,191 points, brokers said.
With 60 minutes left, at 0300 GMT, the index was up 19.28 points or 0.24 percent at 8,182.39, off a high of 8,213.87.
Turnover was an active T$69 billion.

China-concept shares, or companies with invesmtment or investment plans in China, rose most on the back of gains in China-related shares in the Hong Kong stock market ahead of the British colony's handover on July 1, brokers said.
Tyre maker Cheng Shin Rubber surged T$2.3 to T$47.3.
"China-concept shares have risen since Saturday, and whether these shares can continue their strong performance in the future remains to be seen," said Golden Securities research chief Albert Lin.
Electronics were also strong on expected sound outlook, with computer giant Acer up T$3 to T$82, Lin said.
